results.description:
Justice failed them. So he finished the job.

When a recently acquitted criminal is found dead, no one mourns.

No signs of violence. No struggle.

Only a sealed folder left behind — filled with evidence the courts chose to ignore.

Detective Mara Kline quickly realizes this is no ordinary murder. Each victim escaped justice through legal loopholes. Each file proves their guilt beyond doubt. And each of them caused multiple indirect deaths that were never punished.

As bodies begin to surface, the media coins a name that divides a nation:

The Killer Who Saves.

Is he a monster… or the system's correction?

While public opinion turns dangerously sympathetic, prosecutor Jonah Reed insists on a single truth: murder is still murder. Investigative journalist Lena Morales uncovers buried evidence pointing to institutional failures no one wants exposed. And somewhere in the shadows, the killer watches — patient, disciplined, methodical — testing whether the justice system is capable of judging its own crimes.

The Evidence of Guilt is the first book in a gripping moral crime thriller trilogy that asks an unsettling question:

What if justice isn't blind — just afraid?

Dark, intelligent, and provocative, THE KILLER WHO SAVES will appeal to fans of psychological thrillers, ethical crime fiction, and morally complex suspense where there are no safe sides — only consequences.
